title: 第10章 密地第11章 仙师
content_zh:
第10章密地
其实这个结果也是不难猜到，猛虎帮费了这么大的精力，才把大家骗过来，怎么会轻易放他们离开？钱半仙也是恐惧过头了，忘记了猛虎帮的行事风格，结果受到了惩罚。
虎镇嵩缓缓的转过头，见大家都是心有余悸的样子，他笑了笑，道：“刚才出手的是舍弟虎镇恒，这个钱半仙不识抬举，只好教训教训他，不过大家放心，舍弟下手有分寸，他顶多会吐上几两血，不会影响去那密地的，现在正是用人之际，我也舍不得下杀手？”
听到虎镇嵩的话，青阳不禁为钱半仙默哀，受了重伤都没免掉密地之行，这钱半仙以后有罪受了，何苦来哉？虽然虎镇嵩说的客气，但是所有人都明白，这次的密地之行恐怕避免不了了。
果然，虎镇嵩又说出了一些更令大家震惊的事情，道：“大家也不要觉得我猛虎帮行事霸道，这一次的事情其实是为仙师做的，若是其中稍微有点差错，我们整个猛虎帮都要跟着陪葬，所以有谁不愿意去，那都是在要我兄弟几个的性命。”
仙师？竟然真的有仙师，这猛虎帮竟然是为仙师做事的？在场的所有人都被虎镇嵩的这句话给镇住了，青阳更是竖起了耳朵。
仙师，那是传说中的存在，据说能够飞天遁地，杀人于无形，其中的大能者，更是能移山填海，毁天灭世。不过仙师稀少之极，一般也是神龙见首不见尾，普通人只当他是传说，就连松鹤老道和空寂大师这种顶尖的江湖中人，也是只闻其名不见其人。
仙师对于他们这些世俗中人来说，那就是传说中的神仙，当初松鹤老道就是用仙师的幌子把青阳骗上山来的，后来青阳发现上当的时候也已经晚了，只能继续给松鹤老道当徒弟。
想不到这一次竟然从猛虎帮的口中听到了关于仙师的消息，这下青阳等人也都生出了一丝侥幸。能够近距离的接触到传说中的仙师，这一趟哪怕是冒点险也值了，万一哪位仙师看自己资质上佳，愿意收为徒弟，这辈子就发达了，就算是仙师看不上，哪怕只是得到他们随意一些指点，也能受用终生。
看来这次密地之行是必须去了，仙师的名头对大家不光是个诱惑，更是一个震慑，这次猛虎帮找上他们，谁敢保证没有仙师的意见？仙师找你都敢不去？回头就不怕上门报复？
青阳还想到了更深的一点，这些话虎镇嵩完全可以提前说出来，可他偏偏放在了最后，目的就是为了震慑大家，使他们不敢再生出任何的侥幸心理。唯一遗憾的是钱半仙，被虎镇嵩当成了杀鸡儆猴的那只鸡。
虎镇嵩似乎早就料到了大家的反应，道：“你们应该都明白，仙师的事情，容不得半点怠慢。大家难道就没有想过，我猛虎帮为什么找的是你们几位，而不是西平府的其他江湖同道？”
这里虽然聚集了西平府近半的江湖人士，可还有很多高手并没有来，听虎镇嵩这么一说，青阳才忽然想起了这次来的人似乎都比较特殊。钱半仙是个风水先生，杜成金是个盗墓贼，这两人虽然武功不高，但是对于判位走形、勘探挖掘很擅长，正适合在密地里寻宝。
皮应熊是家传的驯兽技能，能够沟通野兽控制鸟禽，有时候遇到危险，完全可以操控动物上去冒险，岂不是比别人多了好几条性命？
至于师父松鹤老道和空寂大师，本身就是顶尖高手，能帮上很大的忙，而且松鹤老道轻功卓绝，还有一手奇妙的缩骨功，空寂大师练有金刚护体神功，又有狮子吼音波攻击，此行或许会有意外的用处。
在场的这些人各怀绝技，而且都很适合用来探索密地，看来猛虎帮找人的时候还是下了一番功夫的。猛虎帮已经把事情做到了这一步，看来这次的事情真的是不容有失啊。
这时，松鹤老道忽然看了看徒儿青阳，脸上漏出一丝不舍之态，道：“虎帮主，这次密地之行危险重重，我这弟子还年轻，没学到什么本事，他就不用去了吧？我松鹤都土埋半截脖子了，就算是把性命卖给你们也无妨，总要给我西平观留下一丝香火。”
师父松鹤的话提醒了其他人，皮应熊也道：“是啊，我女儿去也帮不上什么忙，就让他们三个小孩留下吧。”
虎镇嵩略微犹豫了一下，道：“按说你们的要求不算过分，可这一次事关重大，事成之前不容泄露半点风声，他们三个是肯定要跟去的。不过到了仙师那里，你们可以求一求仙师，让他们三个留在外面。”
虎镇嵩之所以对他们这么客气，一方面是因为松鹤老道与空寂大师实力高绝，身份地位不比他低，另一方面也是为了让这些人尽心办事。以后大家还要一起探密地，若是这帮人心存不满，故意坏了仙师的大事，别人生死无关紧要，自己的猛虎帮也要跟着倒霉。

松鹤老道也就是那么一说，他们也早就料到这件事不好通融，见虎镇嵩都这么说了，也只能暂时作罢，只是不知道那仙师好不好说话，会不会答应大家的要求。其实按照青阳自己的意思，他是愿意去冒这个险的，接触仙师的机会哪有那么多，错过了恐怕这辈子都没有机会了。
既然事情已经商量好了，大家也就没有必要再这么剑拔弩张的了，周围的猛虎帮众人也暂时解除了戒备，过来跟大家见礼。
西平府这边的江湖人士都是猛虎帮调查过的，自然都认识，猛虎帮那边也很好认，除了帮主虎镇嵩以外，其他四个劲装汉子按照年纪从大到小，分别是虎镇泰、虎镇华、虎镇衡、虎镇恒。
这时钱半仙也已经醒了过来，看在大家都是西平府武林同道的份上，松鹤老道与空寂大师并没有对他不管不顾，上前把他扶起来，又找了两颗疗伤丹药喂他服下。
虎镇嵩说的不假，钱半仙的伤势看着严重，却都是内伤，并不影响他的行动，服下丹药之后气色稍微恢复了一些。只是之后钱半仙再也不敢提离开的事情，偶尔看向猛虎帮的几个人，目光中也是带着敬畏和后怕，仍然心有余悸。
新书期，希望大家多多投票支持！
（本章完）
content_en:
Chapter 10 Secret Land
In fact, this result is not difficult to guess. The Tiger Gang spent so much energy to deceive everyone, how could they let them leave so easily? Qian Banxian was too frightened and forgot about the Tiger Gang's behavior, and was punished as a result.
Hu Zhensong slowly turned his head and saw that everyone was still frightened. He smiled and said: "The one who took action just now was my younger brother Hu Zhenheng. This Qian Banxian didn't know how to praise me, so I had to teach him a lesson. But don't worry, everyone, my younger brother has a measured approach. At most, he will vomit a few taels of blood and it will not affect the people going to the secret place. Now is the time to employ people, and I can't bear to kill him?"
Hearing Hu Zhensong's words, Qingyang couldn't help but mourn for Qian Banxian. Even though he was seriously injured, he still had to go to the secret place. This Qian Banxian would be punished in the future, so why bother? Although Hu Zhensong said it politely, everyone understood that this trip to the secret land was probably unavoidable.
Sure enough, Hu Zhensong said something even more shocking to everyone, saying: "Don't think that the Tiger Gang is acting domineeringly. This time, the matter was actually done for the Immortal Master. If there is a slight mistake, our entire Tiger Gang will be buried with him, so if anyone is unwilling to go, it will cost the lives of my brothers."
Immortal master? There really is an Immortal Master, and this Tiger Gang actually works for the Immortal Master? Everyone present was stunned by Hu Zhensong's words, and Qingyang even pricked up his ears.
Immortal masters are legendary beings who are said to be able to fly into the sky, escape from the earth, and kill people invisible. The powerful ones among them can even move mountains and fill seas, and destroy heaven and earth. However, immortal masters are extremely rare, and generally the dragon is seen first but never seen. Ordinary people only regard him as a legend. Even top people in the world, such as Songhe Lao Taoist and Master Kongji, only hear his name but never see his person.
For secular people like them, the Immortal Master is a legendary god. Songhe Master used the guise of the Immortal Master to trick Qingyang into coming to the mountain. Later, when Qingyang found out that he had been deceived, it was too late and he could only continue to be Songhe Master's apprentice.
Unexpectedly, this time they heard news about the Immortal Master from the Tiger Gang, and now Qingyang and others felt a little lucky. Being able to get in close contact with the legendary immortal master, this trip is worth taking even a little risk. If any immortal master sees that he has good qualifications and is willing to accept him as a disciple, he will be prosperous in his life. Even if the immortal master looks down on him, even if he just gets some random advice from them, he will be able to benefit from it for the rest of his life.
It seems that this trip to the secret place is necessary. The name of the Immortal Master is not only a temptation for everyone, but also a deterrent. This time the Tiger Gang comes to them, who can guarantee that there is no opinion from the Immortal Master? Dare you refuse to go to the Immortal Master? Aren't you afraid of coming back for revenge?
Qingyang also thought about a deeper point. Hu Zhensong could have said these words in advance, but he chose to put them at the end. The purpose was to shock everyone and prevent them from taking any chances. The only regret is that Qian Banxian was regarded by Hu Zhensong as the chicken that killed the chicken to scare the monkeys.
Hu Zhensong seemed to have anticipated everyone's reaction, and said: "You should all understand that the matter of the Immortal Master cannot be tolerated in the slightest. Haven't you ever thought about why the Tiger Gang is looking for you and not other fellow Jianghu people in Xiping Mansion?"
Although nearly half of the people in Xiping Mansion were gathered here, there were still many experts who had not come. After hearing what Hu Zhensong said, Qingyang suddenly remembered that the people who came this time seemed to be special. Qian Banxian is a Feng Shui master, and Du Chengjin is a tomb robber. Although these two people are not very good at martial arts, they are very good at judging positions and exploring and excavation, which is suitable for hunting for treasures in dense areas.
Pi Ying Xiong is a family-owned animal taming skill. It can communicate with wild beasts and control birds. Sometimes when encountering danger, you can completely control animals to take risks. Doesn't it mean you have several more lives than others?
As for Master SongheThe old Taoist and Master Kongji are top experts in their own right and can be of great help. Moreover, the old Taoist Songhe has excellent light skills and a wonderful bone-shrinking technique. Master Kongji has practiced the magical power of diamond body protection and lion's roar sonic attack. This trip may be of unexpected use.
These people present each have their own unique skills, and they are all suitable for exploring secret places. It seems that the Tiger Gang has put a lot of effort into finding people. The Tiger Gang has made it this far. It seems that there is really no room for error in this matter.
At this time, Taoist Songhe suddenly looked at his disciple Qingyang, with a trace of reluctance on his face, and said: "Master Tiger, this trip to the secret land is very dangerous. My disciple is still young and has not learned any skills, so he doesn't need to go, right? I, Songhe, have half my neck buried in the soil. Even if I sell my life to you, it doesn't matter. You must leave a trace of incense for me in Xiping Temple."
Master Songhe's words reminded the others, and Pi Yingxiong also said: "Yes, my daughter won't be able to help much, so just let the three children stay."
Hu Zhensong hesitated for a moment and said: "Normally your request is not too much, but this time it is of great importance and no leaks should be allowed until the matter is completed. The three of them will definitely follow. But when you get to the Immortal Master, you can ask the Immortal Master to let the three of them stay outside."
The reason why Hu Zhensong was so polite to them was, on the one hand, because Master Songhe and Master Kongji were extremely powerful and their status was not lower than his, and on the other hand, it was also because he wanted these people to do their best. From now on, everyone will have to explore the secret place together. If this group of people is dissatisfied and deliberately ruins the Immortal Master's important affairs, it won't matter whether others live or die, and his own Tiger Gang will also be in trouble.
That's what Old Taoist Songhe said. They had already expected that this matter would not be accommodating. Seeing that Hu Zhensong had said so, they could only give up temporarily. They just didn't know if the immortal master could speak well and whether he would agree to everyone's request. In fact, according to Qingyang's own wishes, he is willing to take this risk. There are not so many opportunities to contact the immortal master. If he misses it, he may never have the opportunity in this life.
Now that the matter has been discussed, there is no need for everyone to be so tense. The surrounding Tiger Gang people have also temporarily lifted their guard and come to greet everyone.
The Jianghu people in Xiping Mansion have all been investigated by the Tiger Gang, and they all know each other naturally. The Tiger Gang is also easy to recognize. Except for the gang leader Hu Zhensong, the other four well-dressed men in descending order of age are Hu Zhentai, Hu Zhenhua, Hu Zhenheng, and Hu Zhenheng.
At this time, Qian Banxian had also woken up. Seeing that everyone was a martial arts fellow in Xiping Prefecture, Master Songhe and Master Kongji did not ignore him. They stepped forward to help him up and found two healing pills to feed him.
What Hu Zhensong said was true. Qian Banxian's injuries looked serious, but they were all internal injuries and did not affect his actions. After taking the elixir, his complexion recovered a little. But after that, Qian Banxian never dared to mention leaving. He occasionally looked at a few people from the Tiger Gang, with awe and fear in his eyes, and he still felt lingering fear.
New book issue, I hope everyone will vote for it!
(End of chapter)
